title: [test] Multiple failures in test_public_bindings UT with main branch
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Steps to reproduce the issue:
```
# Build PyTorch from source with CUDA support
git clone https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch
cd pytorch
# Follow standard build instructions with CUDA

# Run the failing test
TEST_CONFIG=cpu python3 test/run_test.py --verbose --keep-going -i test_public_bindings
```
